theorems.name: Submission.slicing_support_subset
theorems.statement: ∀ (P m : ℕ) (U : Set (Eucl P)), IsOpen U → ∀ T : GeometricCurrentOn U (m + 1), ∀ (f : Eucl P → ℝ) (L : ℝ≥0), LipschitzOnWith L f U → ∀ (t : ℝ) (S : GeometricCurrentOn U m), IsSlice T f t S → S.support ⊆ T.support ∩ {x | f x = t}
theorems.natural_summary: Implements the independently reviewed natural-language proof; see the theorem issue and retained proof.
